full_prompt_en: A square naive-style coastal painting shows a dark steam boat moving across choppy gray-blue water below a pale town on a low hill. The upper band is a rough off-white sky, marked by a few small black birds and faint gray strokes. Below it, soft gray slopes rise toward a distant ridge dotted with tiny pale houses. A nearer row of cream, beige, and muted brick buildings stands along the shore, their shapes simplified into rectangles with dark roofs, sparse windows, and tiny chimneys. Bare branching trees interrupt the row, one prominent tree near the center. A broad nearly black harbor wall runs horizontally beneath the buildings and firmly divides the town from the water. In the central foreground, a small black vessel has a blunt hull, a thin mast with taut diagonal rigging, and a single upright smokestack releasing a soft gray plume. A small dark figure appears near the back of its deck. Far to the left, a much smaller boat floats close to the wall. Pale strokes and darker slate-blue bands describe uneven waves around the main hull; the lower edge becomes a mass of almost black water. The forms are deliberately flat and slightly irregular, while scratchy, layered paint and visible grain give the whole scene a weathered surface. Diffuse cool daylight keeps the palette muted, with modest warmth in the buildings and narrow highlights on the water rather than a dramatic light source. No readable text is visible. The overall composition stacks sky, town, wall, and sea into simple horizontal bands, setting the dark boat against light water in a quiet yet restless maritime scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的朴拙海岸绘画呈现一艘深色蒸汽船，驶过低丘上的浅色小镇前方起伏的灰蓝色海水。上方是一道粗糙的灰白天空，点着几只细小黑鸟和隐约的灰色笔痕。其下，柔和的灰色坡地抬向远处山脊，脊线上散布微小的浅色房屋。更近的一排奶油色、米色和低饱和砖色建筑沿岸而立，形状被简化为带有深色屋顶、稀疏窗户和小烟囱的矩形。光秃的分枝树木穿插其间，中央附近有一棵显眼的大树。一道宽阔的近黑色港墙从建筑下方水平延伸，明确地将小镇与水面分隔。中央前景的小黑船有钝圆的船身、带绷紧斜拉索的细桅杆，以及一根直立烟囱，烟囱喷出柔灰色烟羽。甲板后部似乎有一位小小的深色人物。远在左侧，还有一艘更小的船靠近港墙漂浮。浅色笔痕与较深的石板蓝色带状区域描绘主船周围不平的波浪；画面下缘则变成一大片近黑色海水。形体刻意平面化且略不规则，刮擦般的层叠颜料和可见颗粒让整幅画带有旧化表面。弥散的冷调日光令配色沉静，建筑只有适度暖意，水面也仅有窄小高光，没有戏剧性的光源。画面没有可读文字。整体构图将天空、小镇、港墙和海面叠成简洁的水平色带，让深色船只在浅色海水前突出，形成一幅安静却又波动不息的海景。
style_prompt_en: This painted style reduces complex space to stacked, slightly uneven bands and simple blocklike silhouettes. The brushwork is dry, scratched, and visibly granular, so flat areas retain the feel of a worn handmade surface. Near-black masses anchor the lower region and strong dark horizontals interrupt softer fields of slate blue, foggy gray, warm cream, and muted brick. Small light marks flicker against the dark areas, creating movement without smooth rendering. Depth comes from changes in scale and overlapping bands rather than strict perspective; distant forms are small and pale, while foreground shapes are broad and emphatic. Diffuse light keeps contrasts localized, and restrained warm notes give life to an otherwise cool palette. The overall visual effect is direct, weathered, and gently irregular, with narrative clarity emerging from economical painted shapes.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画风格将复杂空间缩减为层叠而略不平整的色带和简洁的块状剪影。笔触干涩、带刮擦感且颗粒清晰，因此平涂区域仍保有磨旧手工表面的触感。近黑色大块稳住下方区域，强烈的深色水平线切开较柔和的石板蓝、雾灰、暖奶油色和低饱和砖色。细小的亮色笔痕在暗处闪动，不借助平滑塑形也能产生运动感。纵深来自尺度变化与色带重叠，而非严格透视；远处形态小而浅，前景形状宽阔而有力。弥散光让对比集中在局部，克制的暖色又为总体偏冷的配色增添生命。整体视觉效果直接、旧化、略显不规则，用简练的颜料形状形成清晰叙事。
theme_en: A dark steam boat crossing rough water before a small coastal town
theme_zh: 深色蒸汽船驶过小海镇前的波浪
name: Alfred Wallis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
